sources.ref: Moondrop Custom EQ web app 1.8.0 build 26B1107 (https://hub.moondroplab.com/), bundle assets/index-iHwVcdAT.js: device table, Echo-BP config

meta.notes: 32 bands, and a pre-gain of -80 to 0 dB in steps of 0.1. The app sends the band parameters only and the device computes its own filters (inferred: the coefficient area is left empty). The app does not support it on macOS below firmware 2.0.0. It has no built-in presets and no slot switch. This is not the Conexant protocol of the ECHO-B. Its USB product name is unknown, so only the ids match.
